summary: Atlas Lithium Corp filed an 8-K to disclose two non-special-situation items: a compensation increase for CFO Tiago Miranda, including a $360,000 base salary, cash bonus opportunity, and RSU grant, as well as the resolution of a Brazilian civil action via a court-approved agreement with NGO N Golo. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic change is involved; it is a routine compensation arrangement and litigation update.
